message: The other day, I was rummaging through old boxes in the attic and stumbled upon my childhood fire escape plan. It was just a simple drawing with arrows pointing to the nearest exits and a big ‘X’ for the safe meeting spot outside. It made me chuckle, but also reminded me how important it is to have a clear escape plan in case of emergencies. Sometimes, we get so caught up in the latest tech that we forget the basics can be pretty fun too. Have you and your family made a fire escape plan lately? It could spark some good conversations!
